attribution: Portland Civic Lab; underlying records: Oregon Secretary of State ORESTAR. Cite the snapshot and source dates.
coverage: All current records held in our published Oregon ledger, not all ORESTAR history or a complete election cycle. Includes all observed filers, not only council/governor campaigns. Federal FEC records are excluded.
limitations: Manual-export coverage is provisional; older-dated late filings, removals and amendments outside the supplied exports may be missing.
Archived maps, balances, event interpretations and network tests retain their individual dates.
No donor street addresses, donor-level ZIP codes, employer/occupation fields, unrestricted purpose descriptions or private research files are included.
